profile.headline: Software Engineer | Gen AI | Data | Cloud-Native ETL Automation
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer – (HCLTech | Client: Ocean Spray Cranberries)
profile.summary: Backend / AI Platform Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building cloud-native APIs, logistics platforms, event-driven pipelines, and LLM applications using Python, TypeScript, Azure, Kubernetes, SQL, and Redis.

positions.title: Software Engineer – (HCLTech | Client: Ocean Spray Cranberries)
positions.description:
Built a production-grade NL→SQL / NL→KQL conversational data platform using LangGraph, FastAPI, Azure Container Apps, and Azure OpenAI, helping reduce turnaround time for ad-hoc data analysis.
Designed and developed a logistics orchestration platform supporting shipment lifecycle, inventory distribution, and middle-mile transportation across plants, warehouses, and distribution centers.
Built scalable TypeScript/Node.js microservices and APIs for shipment creation, tracking, reconciliation, and workflow automation.
Developed a Kubernetes-based shipment state-machine service and integrated real-time shipment/vehicle events, webhooks, ETA reconciliation, delay detection, and automated retries.
Built a real-time inventory visibility and reconciliation pipeline using Azure SQL Change Tracking, Azure Storage Queues, and Python Azure Functions, significantly reducing manual reconciliation effort.
Improved system performance and reliability through SQL optimization, Redis caching, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Datadog, Azure Monitor, and PagerDuty, including an ~80% reduction in p95 latency for key shipment-query APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer I — Titan Technologies (Client – U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics)
positions.description:
Designed and maintained Python/SQL ETL pipelines to ingest, cleanse, validate, and transform large-scale employment and wage datasets, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with U.S. BLS reporting standards.
Automated manual SAS and spreadsheet workflows into version-controlled Python batch pipelines with Git/CI-CD practices, reducing processing time by ~50% and improving reproducibility for labor-market analytics and policy reporting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assisted in backend application development by translating business requirements into user stories, API specifications, data flows, and Swagger-based contracts, ensuring alignment between frontend requirements and backend data models.
Collaborated with product, QA, and engineering teams to validate edge cases, execute unit/integration/automation tests, maintain JIRA/Confluence documentation, and improve release readiness and post-release reliability.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developed complete web application having object oriented architecture named Cold Storage Inventory Management to make the procedure of stock administration and detailing easy.
Tools and Technologies Used : HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL

certifications.name: Applied Data Science Program: Leveraging AI for Effective Decision-Making
certifications.title: Applied Data Science Program: Leveraging AI for Effective Decision-Making

projects.title: Airline Dataset Analysis
projects.description:
Hadoop Project - Performed big data analysis on airline datasets - airport, carriers and plane details using big data tools - Pig, Hive and Impala.
Purpose of the project to summarize, analyze and visualize datasets differently.
Tools and Technologies Used : Hadoop, HDFS, Pig, Hive and Impala, Data Analysis using Microsoft Excel

projects.title: Face Recognition
projects.description:
Machine learning project on face recognition and technique used to classify photos as “George Bush” and “Not George Bush” or to classify photos as “Serena Williams” and “Not Serena Williams” using different classification techniques KNN, SVC and PCA.
Comparison between: analysis of Bush-Williams datasets with Cat-Dog Kaggle Datasets.
Tools and Technologies Used : Python (methods provided by the scikitlearn package)
